Carry out that the moisture regain% of jute morah has been taken properly for future reference
Carry out that the cut roots of Jute strand (reed) are kept/stored in a separate stack for billing
Check the colour coding of different quality of Jute, as per quality & grade of raw jute (TD3- TD7), or the display board (mentioned the jute grade) in case of piled jute

modules.module_title: Identifying of yarn faults and rectification

pcs.pc_description: Check whether the jute sliver quality and jute yarn quality according to desired quality standards and specifications for the specific industry
Carry out that proper identification mark is always present for different counts of jute yarns being spun or wound
Carry out that uniform bobbin weight is maintained in spinning machine (Yarn Unevenness, Mechanical Reasons)
Check and arrange replacement of defective machine parts of spinning and winding machinery by maintenance people in jute mills
Carry out proper wound angle and diameter in spool (warp package) and proper dia, cone length and length of the cop for jute weft (cop) yarn

Carry out the right piecing (minimum overlapping of sliver) in spinning and minimum overlapping in jute yarn in winding machine by appropriate method and use of coloured yarn while piecing export quality yarn
Find out the causes of end break in spinning machine, end break in winding(warp and weft) machine and take the remedial measures for excessive end breakage
Check frequently the quality of bobbin and spool and ensure that quality standards and specifications are maintained
Carry out join the broken ends by piecing in spinning frame & proper weavers’ knots using mechanical knotter
Carry out the knots small and tight, with minimum yarn wastage
Carry out that winding tension in all drum/spindles are same and uniform throughout winding operation
Explain cause wise Loss in Efficiency % for in Jute Spreader / Softener, Carding, Drawing, Spinning, Winding, Pre-beaming, weaving and Jute Finishing Stages
Minimise unnecessary wastage of yarn while removing faults or during starting of winding and knotting
Carry out Quality wise Norms for Wastage at the Different Stages of Processing
Report immediately to the supervisor or concern superiors, if any technological or mechanical problem occurs in machine
